summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container in the RDFLib SPARQL plugin, as specified. Changes: (1) rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py adds an Update(prologue, algebra) class beside Query. (2) rdflib/plugins/sparql/algebra.py: translateUpdate always returns an Update; the empty path builds the prologue from the single declaration group q.prologue[0] with base and initNs and returns an empty algebra list; the non-empty path returns Update(prologue, res). Update is imported from sparql.py. (3) rdflib/plugins/sparql/update.py: evalUpdate iterates update.algebra and its docstring says it takes an Update container. (4) rdflib/plugins/sparql/processor.py: new prepareUpdate(updateString, initNs={}, base=None) beside prepareQuery, recording _original_args; processUpdate and the update processor are unchanged. (5) rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py exports prepareUpdate. (6) New test/test_sparql_prepare.py covers prepare and apply via Graph.update, reuse across graphs, initNs resolution, initial bindings, direct evaluation, container shape, empty and declarations-only requests, empty strings, and the no-mutation snapshot check. Not verified: per instructions I did not run tests or black; the initial-bindings test assumes an empty WHERE yields one solution carrying the bindings. No commit was made.
